decision_basis: source time coverage and pre-outcome sampling feasibility only

demographic_source.supporting_source: Ya Ha Tinda Elk Project Annual Report 2018-2019 states recruitment series 2001-2018; tabulated late-winter ratios span 2002-2018 with 2008 missing.

mapping: autumn year t predicts late-winter calf:cow ratio in t+1 and requires the preceding ratio at t
prohibited_rescues: do not lower the minimum of 11 annual observations
do not extend the frozen Dryad outcome series with later annual-report values
do not change the forecast horizon
do not lower the n=10 daily movement gate
do not replace the primary endpoint with a secondary endpoint
interpretation: The frozen Ya Ha Tinda primary cannot supply the required rolling-origin future-demography test even under perfect movement coverage. This is an identifiability/sample-overlap STOP, not a null result for the Love-Otto metric.
